announcements.headline: Appointment of Nominated Adviser and Sole Broker
announcements.insight: ProService's appointment of a sole broker signals a critical pivot to enhance liquidity and market visibility for this AIM-listed building services marketplace, addressing the chronic illiquidity that often hampers valuation in the fragmented construction tech sector.
